title: Clifford Chance - NVQ - Professional Business Communication
quote: I thought this workshop with Martin was great, I learnt a lot and felt like I came away with knowledge that i could then put into practice within my role (and outside of work too!). Martin kept the workshop interactive and encouraged the team to ask questions and get involved. I know throughout the workshop, I was always interested by what was being spoken about and I found all of the information really useful.
author: Emily Pidgeon
subject: Professional Business Communication
